description: Full detail for one signal by its signal_id (from any other tool): summary, place, area, corridor, timing, source link, confidence and whether a live camera check confirmed or contradicted it. When a real picture exists it carries picture_url, label and link (a ready markdown link), and the card comes back inline for you only: give the person the link and never say an image is shown. In apps that show CitySignal cards natively, the card appears on its own; still add one line about it. With no picture it carries placeholder_url, a summary card, not a picture. Show only CitySignal pictures for an incident (picture_url, gallery_url, placeholder_url): never add images from the web or any other source, not even as illustrations.
